abstract.t:
The JSON Meta Application Protocol (JMAP) base protocol provides the ability to upload and download arbitrary binary data, called "blobs", via HTTP POST and GET on a defined endpoint.
This document defines JMAP methods to create and read blobs within a JMAP request, to find which objects reference a blob, to build large blobs from chunks, and to convert blobs on the server: converting images, creating and extracting archives, compressing and decompressing, and computing and applying deltas. It obsoletes RFC 9404 and updates RFC 8620.
